expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Planned v2 work will extend the protocol with request identifiers for correlating messages, timestamps for recording message creation time, and an optional payload field for carrying message data while preserving the existing Ping roundtrip behavior.

Shipped: v2 `Hello(String)` with the explicit `v:2|hello|<name>` envelope.
